vendoringDecision.rationale: Freeze the exact inherited source during the TaiChiOS 0.1 migration so provenance and the legacy behavioral baseline remain independently auditable.

localPatches.reason: Adjust root TypeScript config paths after moving the unchanged snapshot under vendor/cordis.

steps: Select and record an immutable upstream commit.
Review the full upstream diff and license before replacing files.
Update package identities, license digest, and the explicit patch queue.
Run compat:cordis, build, lint, and the full inherited test suite.

exitStrategy.condition: TaiChiOS-owned acceptance no longer depends on the inherited Cordis suite.
exitStrategy.action: Remove vendor/cordis and its root workspace entry; continue consuming the official published runtime lock.
exitStrategy.retainedProvenance: Git parent history and the cordiverse/cordis upstream remote retain the source history.
